prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training preparation with high carbohydrate intake for endurance and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes at least 3 meals strategically timed around training windows
Daily caloric intake and macronutrient distribution (carbs emphasis) are appropriate for marathon training
All meals respect dietary restrictions (vegetarian, nut-free)
Format is compact and concise (1 day only)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring calorie-dense, carbohydrate-heavy meals with specific timing around training windows

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains only vegan foods and beverages
Provides adequate protein (minimum 1.6g per kg body weight) from plant-based sources
Includes carbohydrate-rich meals for endurance cycling fuel
All meals are practical to prepare and consume in a single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an athlete with dietary restrictions (vegan endurance cyclist) to verify the meal plan accommodates nutritional constraints while meeting athletic performance needs

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength performance optimization

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers exactly 1 day with 4-5 distinct meals/snacks
Minimum 1.8g protein per kg body weight (162g total) distributed across meals
Includes micronutrients supporting muscle recovery (iron, magnesium, zinc, B vitamins)
Compact format with concise descriptions (no lengthy recipes or explanations)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-optimized meals with micronutrient balance for muscle recovery and performance
